amendment_history.note: الإصدار الأصلي المُثبت نصه في هذا المسار (17 مادة) -- تصديقًا على القانون (النظام) الموحد الصادر بقرار المجلس الأعلى لدول مجلس التعاون لدول الخليج العربية في دورته الرابعة والعشرين (الكويت، 27-28/شوال/1424هـ الموافق 21-22/ديسمبر/2003م)، وقرار مجلس الوزراء رقم (122) وتاريخ 16/5/1427هـ. بحسب صفحة هيئة الخبراء الحالية (Wayback Machine)، هذا لا يزال النص المعروض تحت هذا العنوان، بحالة 'ساري'، دون أي علامة تعديل على مستوى المادة.

amendment_history.decree: المرسوم الملكي رقم (م/7) -- نصه لم يُعتمد في هذا المسار
amendment_history.note: بحسب WIPO Lex (السجل SA086) وبحسب الديباجة الرسمية لنظام لاحق منشور على بوابة هيئة الخبراء ونافذ حاليًا (نظام المعالجات التجارية في التجارة الدولية، المرسوم الملكي م/60 وتاريخ 29/4/1444هـ)، صدَّق هذا المرسوم على نسخة (معدلة) من القانون (النظام) الموحد، ينسبها WIPO Lex إلى إحلال محل نص م/30. لكن صفحة هيئة الخبراء الأساسية لهذا القانون (المصدر الأساسي المعتمد لنصوص هذا المسار) لا تزال تعرض النص الأصلي (17 مادة) بموجب م/30 فقط، دون أي إشارة إلى م/7 أو أي علامة تعديل على مستوى المادة. النص الفعلي الذي صدَّق عليه م/7 لم يُثبت في هذا المسار -- فجوة موثقة (انظر known_unresolved_discrepancies، المفتاح gcc_anti_dumping_m7_1434h_amended_text_not_incorporated).

chapter_structure.label_ar: بدون تقسيم إلى أبواب أو فصول
chapter_structure.title_ar: مواد متسلسلة غير مجمعة تحت أبواب أو فصول رسمية (كل مادة تحمل عنوانها الفرعي الخاص بها كما وردت في صفحة هيئة الخبراء): الهدف والنطاق، التعاريف، فرض التدابير، التدابير المؤقتة، التدابير النهائية، أشكال التدابير، إجراءات الشكوى والتحقيق، تشكيل اللجنة الدائمة، اختصاصات اللجنة الدائمة، اللجنة الوزارية، الأمانة الفنية للجنة الدائمة، الطعن، سرية المعلومات، الجزاءات، اللائحة التنفيذية، [بدون عنوان فرعي في المصدر]، النفاذ

verification_methodology_note:
PRIMARY SOURCE ACCESS: laws.boe.gov.sa's LIVE portal was unreachable this pass for this law (direct HTTPS curl to the exact law-detail URL [https://laws.boe.gov.sa/BoeLaws/Laws/LawDetails/0da0543b-72bf-4405-98f3-a9a700f1c593/1] returned curl exit code 35 / "Recv failure: Connection reset by peer"; the plain http:// scheme returned HTTP 503). HOWEVER, archive.org/wayback/available confirmed TWO separate Wayback Machine snapshots of this exact BOE law-detail page (timestamps 20231112034551 and 20250619192625, roughly 20 months apart) -- the more recent (20250619192625) was fetched directly via https:// (HTTP 200, 72038 bytes) and used as this track's primary source; both snapshots show the identical unamended 17-article state, ruling out a single-crawl fluke. The archived page was parsed with BeautifulSoup (not naive regex/tag-stripping): each of 17 'article_item' divs carries an 'h3.center' heading (article ordinal + inline title, e.g. "المادة الأولى : الهدف والنطاق") and a 'div.HTMLContainer' body (article text, with
tags converted to newlines to preserve enumerated sub-item formatting) -- recovering the complete, exact text of all 17 articles. All 17 'article_item' divs carry ONLY the class 'no_alternate' (BOE's no-op/default marker), with zero occurrences of any amended/repealed marker class anywhere on the page. BOE's own page-level metadata fields read: الاسم (title) = "القانون \"النظام\" الموحد لمكافحة الإغراق والتدابير التعويضية والوقائية لدول مجلس التعاون لدول الخليج العربية"; تاريخ الإصدار = 17/5/1427هـ (13/06/2006م); تاريخ النشر = 25/6/1427هـ (21/07/2006م); الحالة (status) = "ساري" (in force); أدوات إصدار النظام (issuance instruments) = "مرسوم ملكي رقم م/30 بتاريخ 17 / 5 / 1427" and "قرار مجلس الوزراء رقم 122 بتاريخ 16 / 5 / 1427" -- BOE lists NO other issuing instrument for this lawId, and no per-article amendment markers exist anywhere on the page. SECONDARY CROSS-VERIFICATION (structural, partial): qistas.com (a Gulf-region legal-text aggregator, fetched live this pass) independently hosts a page under the identical Arabic title, and the excerpt retrieved from it opens with the same three-article sequence and content found on BOE: Article 1 combining "الهدف والنطاق" (goal and scope) in one article, Article 2 "التعاريف" (definitions) with matching defined terms (المجلس، اللجنة الوزارية، اللجنة الدائمة، الأمانة الفنية، الإغراق، الدعم، الزيادة غير المبررة في الواردات), and Article 3 "فرض التدابير" (imposition of measures) with matching substantive content on material-injury findings. This independently corroborates BOE's 17-article numbering/structure for at least Articles 1-3; qistas.com's fetched excerpt did not surface the full 17-article text, so this is recorded as a PARTIAL (not full-text) independent structural cross-check, consistent with this corpus's stated 1-2-verification-attempts-per-fact policy (see known_unresolved_discrepancies, key gcc_anti_dumping_qistas_partial_cross_check_only). MAJOR DISCREPANCY -- A CANDIDATE 2013 AMENDMENT NOT REFLECTED IN THE INGESTED TEXT: WIPO Lex's bibliographic record (SA086, https://www.wipo.int/wipolex/ar/legislation/details/20288, fetched this pass) states that "القانون (النظام) الموحد لمكافحة الإغراق والتدابير التعويضية والوقائية لدول مجلس التعاون لدول الخليج العربية" was re-issued for Saudi Arabia via Royal Decree No. (M/7) dated 20/3/1434H (1 February 2013, entry into force 23 February 2013), and that this M/7 text "supersedes" the M/30 (2006) text catalogued separately by WIPO Lex as record SA034. This was independently corroborated this pass by fetching (via Wayback Machine) a WHOLLY SEPARATE, newer Saudi law's own official BOE-hosted page: "نظام المعالجات التجارية في التجارة الدولية" (the national Trade Remedies Law, Royal Decree M/60 dated 29/4/1444H [23 November 2022], Council of Ministers Resolution No. 321 dated 28/4/1444H) -- that law's own preamble/Council-of-Ministers-Resolution text, read in full this pass, explicitly defines the term "النظام الموحد" (rendered in that 2022 law as: "النظام الموحد : النظام (القانون) الموحد لمكافحة الإغراق والتدابير التعويضية والوقائية لدول مجلس التعاون لدول الخليج العربية (المعدل)") and separately states this defined term "الموافق عليه بالمرسوم الملكي رقم (م / 7) وتاريخ 20 / 3 / 1434هـ" -- i.e. a wholly independent, currently-in-force (status "ساري" per BOE) 2022 Saudi Royal Decree explicitly cites Royal Decree M/7 (20/3/1434H) by number and date as having approved an amended ("المعدل") version of this Unified Law, and the same 2022 law's Council of Ministers Resolution further mentions ongoing revenue-sharing arrangements tied to measures imposed under BOTH the new national law AND "النظام (القانون) الموحد ... (المعدل)... الموافق عليه بالمرسوم الملكي رقم (م / 7)" -- treating the M/7-ratified amended Unified Law as a currently-operative, parallel instrument (not one that itself has been repealed by the 2022 law). FURTHER CORROBORATION AND THE SCOPE OF THE AMENDMENT: the GCC Secretariat General's own official publication (gcc-sg.org, fetched live this pass as a 20-page PDF via pdftotext, a bundled booklet titled "القانون (النظام) الموحد لمكافحة الإغراق والتدابير التعويضية والوقائية لدول مجلس التعاون لدول الخليج العربية ولائحته التنفيذية" and explicitly subtitled "(المعدل)" on its own cover/catalogue page) contains a Law text that is STRUCTURALLY DIFFERENT from the 17-article BOE text ingested in this track: it has only 15 articles, restructured and renumbered relative to the original -- e.g. original Article 1 ("الهدف والنطاق", combined) is split into new Article 1 ("الهدف") and new Article 2 ("النطاق"); original Articles 3-5 ("فرض التدابير" / "التدابير المؤقتة" / "التدابير النهائية") are consolidated into a single new Article 5 ("التدابير"); original Articles 8-11 ("تشكيل اللجنة الدائمة" / "اختصاصات اللجنة الدائمة" / "اللجنة الوزارية" / "الأمانة الفنية للجنة الدائمة") are reorganized into new Articles 7-10 with an added new Article 7 ("تطبيق أحكام القانون (النظام) ولائحته التنفيذية") not present in the original 17-article text; original Article 15 ("اللائحة التنفيذية") does not survive as a standalone article in the amended numbering. The GCC-SG booklet's own front matter documents the GCC-level approval chain for this amendment: the Industrial Cooperation Committee's 31st meeting (Kuwait, 2 June 2010) approved the Implementing Regulation and recommended the Law amendment to the Financial and Economic Cooperation Committee; that Committee approved the amendment at its 86th meeting (Kuwait, 6 November 2010); and the GCC Supreme Council blessed the amendment at its 31st Session (Abu Dhabi, 6-7 December 2010). Per WIPO Lex and the 2022 law's own preamble (both independent of the GCC-SG booklet), Saudi Arabia is stated to have domestically ratified this GCC-level-amended text via Royal Decree M/7 dated 20/3/1434H (1 February 2013) -- roughly two years after the GCC-level blessing, which is a plausible domestic-ratification lag consistent with how other GCC member states are documented to have ratified the same amendment on their own, later timelines (e.g. Oman via Royal/Sultani Decree No. 20/2015, Kuwait via Law No. 110/2015, per web search results reviewed this pass). RESOLUTION TAKEN THIS PASS (and why): despite this credible, multiply-corroborated evidence of a 2013 domestic ratification of an amended, differently-structured 15-article text, THIS TRACK INGESTS BOE's DIRECTLY-VERIFIED 17-ARTICLE ORIGINAL TEXT (Royal Decree M/30, 17/5/1427H) as its official_source articles[], NOT the GCC-SG's 15-article amended text, because: (a) BOE -- this corpus's designated first-choice primary domestic-law source -- currently serves the 17-article text as the operative law under this exact title, with status field "ساري" (in force) and zero on-page reference to M/7 or any 2013 amendment, across two Wayback snapshots roughly 20 months apart; (b) this pass could NOT independently obtain or verify the exact Saudi-Gazette-published wording of Royal Decree M/7 itself -- a targeted Umm Al-Qura Gazette web search for "م/7" + "1434" + this law's subject matter returned no dedicated primary-source hit, and WIPO Lex's full-text PDF endpoints for both SA034 (the 2006/M-30 record) and SA086 (the 2013/M-7 record) could not be retrieved as raw PDF/HTML content this pass -- both wipolex-res.wipo.int and www.wipo.int endpoints returned only a generic JavaScript-shell HTML wrapper (identical ~37KB payload for every URL tried) rather than the underlying document, a tooling/access limitation, not a confirmation either way of the amended text's exact Saudi-ratified wording; (c) fabricating or silently substituting the GCC Secretariat's generic-GCC-level amended text as if it were this track's confirmed, Saudi-Gazette-verified "official_source" content would risk exactly the kind of unverified-text risk this corpus's trust policy forbids. This is recorded as this track's single most important documented discrepancy (known_unresolved_discrepancies, key gcc_anti_dumping_m7_1434h_amended_text_not_incorporated) rather than silently picking one candidate text over the other without flagging the conflict. A future pass with access to Umm Al-Qura Gazette's own archive (or a working WIPO Lex full-text fetch) could resolve this decisively. STRUCTURE: this Law is NOT subdivided into أبواب (parts) or فصول (chapters) -- it is a flat sequence of 17 individually-titled articles (each BOE 'article_item' carries its own inline h3 title, e.g. "الهدف والنطاق", "التعاريف", "فرض التدابير", ... "النفاذ") with no grouping/part headers anywhere on the BOE page. This corrects an assumption in this corpus's own coverage-gap-map research note and in this track's initial task brief, both of which anticipated a typical GCC-unified-law باب/فصل structure (general provisions/definitions, anti-dumping investigations and duties, countervailing/subsidy investigations and duties, safeguard measures, common procedural/final provisions) -- the actual verified BOE text has no such formal grouping; see known_unresolved_discrepancies. ARTICLE 16 HEADING GAP: BOE's own h3 heading for Article 16 ("المادة السادسة عشرة") is followed immediately by a colon and no title text (unlike all 16 other articles, each of which carries an inline title after the colon) -- this is preserved exactly as BOE renders it (no title fabricated); see known_unresolved_discrepancies. IMPLEMENTING REGULATION: confirmed to exist (referenced by original Article 15, "تصدر لجنة التعاون الصناعي اللائحة التنفيذية لهذا القانون (النظام)", and bundled together with the amended Law text in the GCC-SG's own 20-page PDF booklet). Consistent with this corpus's established precedent (finance_lease_law, banking_control_law, insurance_control_law, finance_companies_law, cooperative_health_insurance_law, healthcare_professions_law), this track ingests ONLY the primary Law; the Implementing Regulation is flagged as a follow-up candidate, not fabricated or partially guessed at. GAP-MAP ESTIMATE CORRECTED: this corpus's own coverage_gap_map.json entry for this law estimated "Approx. 30-40 articles -- needs confirmation". This pass's direct BOE verification corrects that estimate downward: the original (M/30, 1427H) text has exactly 17 articles. (This correction applies to the ORIGINAL text ingested in this track; the separately-documented candidate amended text has a different, 15-article count -- see the M/7 discrepancy above; neither figure is "30-40".) No legal text is altered beyond whitespace normalization (collapsing repeated spaces, converting
tags to newlines) needed to render BOE's HTML as plain text. Arabic governs; no translation/paraphrase/interpretation performed on the Arabic text (English descriptions in this note and in document_en/issuing_authority_en are for indexing only). Read-only over input; deterministic over outputs.

known_unresolved_discrepancies.description: This track's single most important documented discrepancy. WIPO Lex (record SA086) states that Royal Decree No. (M/7) dated 20/3/1434H (1 February 2013) approved an AMENDED ('المعدل') version of this Unified Law for Saudi Arabia, and that this M/7 text 'supersedes' the M/30 (17/5/1427H, 2006) text this track actually ingests (WIPO Lex record SA034). This was independently corroborated this pass by a wholly separate, newer Saudi law's own official BOE-hosted preamble/Council-of-Ministers-Resolution text -- 'نظام المعالجات التجارية في التجارة الدولية' (Royal Decree M/60, 29/4/1444H/23 Nov 2022, currently 'ساري') -- which explicitly defines 'النظام الموحد' as 'النظام (القانون) الموحد لمكافحة الإغراق والتدابير التعويضية والوقائية لدول مجلس التعاون لدول الخليج العربية (المعدل)، الموافق عليه بالمرسوم الملكي رقم (م / 7) وتاريخ 20 / 3 / 1434هـ'. Further, the GCC Secretariat General's own official PDF booklet (gcc-sg.org, fetched live and read in full this pass) contains a differently-structured, 15-article '(المعدل)' text (vs. this track's 17 articles) -- e.g. original Article 1 'الهدف والنطاق' splits into amended Articles 1 'الهدف' and 2 'النطاق'; original Articles 3-5 ('فرض التدابير'/'التدابير المؤقتة'/'التدابير النهائية') consolidate into amended Article 5 ('التدابير'); original Articles 8-11 reorganize into amended Articles 7-10 with a new Article 7 ('تطبيق أحكام القانون (النظام) ولائحته التنفيذية') not present in the original. Despite this multiply-corroborated evidence, BOE's own primary catalog page for this law (lawId 0da0543b-72bf-4405-98f3-a9a700f1c593, this track's actual source, checked across two Wayback snapshots 20 months apart) lists ONLY M/30 and Council of Ministers Resolution 122 as issuing instruments, shows zero per-article amendment markers, and its own status field reads 'ساري' with no reference anywhere to M/7 or a 2013 amendment. This pass could NOT independently retrieve the exact Saudi-Gazette-published wording of M/7 itself (a targeted Umm Al-Qura Gazette search returned no dedicated hit; WIPO Lex's full-text PDF endpoints for both SA034 and SA086 returned only a generic JS-shell HTML wrapper rather than the underlying document for every URL variant tried this pass). This track therefore ingests BOE's directly-verified 17-article ORIGINAL (M/30) text rather than silently substituting the GCC-SG's amended 15-article text, which this pass could not confirm verbatim against a Saudi-Gazette-level primary source. A future pass with access to the Umm Al-Qura Gazette archive or a working WIPO Lex full-text fetch could resolve this decisively -- until then, any use of this track's text should treat the possibility of a 2013 amendment as a live, unresolved risk, not a settled negative finding.

laws.boe.gov.sa's LIVE portal returned curl exit code 35 (connection reset by peer) over HTTPS and HTTP 503 over plain HTTP for this law's exact detail URL, repeated attempts, this pass. Two Wayback Machine snapshots of the identical URL (20231112034551 and 20250619192625) were both reachable and show an identical unamended 17-article state; the more recent snapshot (20250619192625, fetched directly via https://, HTTP 200, 72038 bytes) was used as this track's primary source. No hostname tricks or bypass beyond the two established proxies (Wayback Machine / direct live fetch) were used.

BOE's own h3 heading for المادة السادسة عشرة (Article 16) reads only 'المادة السادسة عشرة :' with no title text following the colon -- unlike all 16 other articles on the same BOE page, each of which carries an inline descriptive title after the colon (e.g. 'المادة الخامسة عشرة : اللائحة التنفيذية'). This track preserves this exactly as BOE renders it (title_ar recorded as an empty string for this article) rather than inventing a plausible-sounding title (the article's substantive content concerns interpretation/amendment authority vested in the GCC Financial and Economic Cooperation Committee, but no official BOE-sourced short title for it was found).

This track's own build brief anticipated a typical GCC-unified-law باب/فصل structure (general provisions/definitions, anti-dumping investigations and duties, countervailing/subsidy investigations and duties, safeguard measures, common procedural/final provisions) -- this corpus's own coverage_gap_map.json entry for this law made no such claim, but the task brief for this build pass did. The actual BOE-verified text has NO such formal grouping: it is a flat sequence of 17 individually-titled articles, each with its own inline h3 title, but with no باب or فصل heading element anywhere on the BOE page. This track's chapter_structure field reflects this verified flat structure (a single leaf range 1-17) rather than inventing a topical grouping not present in the primary source.

This corpus's own reports/coverage_gap_map/coverage_gap_map.json entry for this law estimated 'Approx. 30-40 articles -- needs confirmation'. This pass's direct BOE verification corrects that estimate downward: the ORIGINAL (M/30, 1427H) text ingested in this track has exactly 17 articles. This correction applies only to the original text; the separately-documented candidate amended (معدل) text found via the GCC Secretariat General's own PDF has a different, 15-article count -- see gcc_anti_dumping_m7_1434h_amended_text_not_incorporated above. Neither figure matches the gap map's '30-40' estimate; both are lower.

The Law's companion Implementing Regulation (اللائحة التنفيذية) is confirmed to exist -- referenced by this track's own original Article 15 ('تصدر لجنة التعاون الصناعي اللائحة التنفيذية لهذا القانون (النظام)') and bundled together with the amended Law text in the GCC Secretariat General's own 20-page PDF booklet (gcc-sg.org, fetched live this pass) under the combined title '...ولائحته التنفيذية'. Consistent with this corpus's established precedent for finance_lease_law, banking_control_law, insurance_control_law, finance_companies_law, cooperative_health_insurance_law and healthcare_professions_law (each of which identified but did not ingest its companion Implementing Regulation in the same pass as the primary Law), this track ingests ONLY the primary Law. The Implementing Regulation -- including whatever amendment history attaches to it independently of the M/7 question above -- is documented here as a candidate for a dedicated follow-up ingestion pass, not fabricated or partially guessed at.

qistas.com's fetched excerpt of this law (used as this track's secondary cross-verification source) confirmed only the first three articles' content/structure against BOE's text, not the full 17-article text -- the fetch tool returned a partial page summary rather than the complete underlying document. Consistent with this corpus's stated 1-2-verification-attempts-per-fact policy, this is recorded as a PARTIAL, structural cross-check (confirms BOE's article numbering/topic sequence for Articles 1-3) rather than a full independent re-verification of all 17 articles' exact wording.
